For decades, Scott has served as a pillar of the Bryan-College Station community. He has always been a tough but fair host, with a wealth of knowledge about local, federal, & global issues. While his voice will be missed, I wish him and his family all the best in this new season!

Today, we remember & honor the millions of Americans who made the ultimate sacrifice for their fellow countrymen. Our nation & our world owe them a debt we will never be able to repay. As we gather with family & friends this Memorial Day, let us not forget the price of freedom.🇺🇸

It's always a pleasure to welcome the @BCSChamber to Washington for their annual fly-in! I'm honored to represent Bryan-College Station and grateful to hear from local leaders about how Congress can help this vibrant community thrive.

Huge congrats to @AggieWTEN on winning another national championship! Your perseverance, grit, and heart on the court have made us proud. #Whoop!

As chairman of the Congressional Special Events Task Force, I had the pleasure of meeting with @WHTaskForceFIFA executive director @AndrewHGiuliani today in my office. 

Our respective task forces have worked together for months to help ensure the World Cup is safe and fun for all. We look forward to a great summer of events that showcase American excellence!

This week, we recognize the brave men and women who protect and serve our communities. Law enforcement officers risk their lives every day to keep us safe. I'm proud to stand with @HouseGOP in honoring their courage and sacrifice.

My Guard the Skies Act would leverage the National Guard—a force prepared for rapid deployment & crisis response—to protect our skies & the gatherings below. This bipartisan bill will ensure these events reflect American excellence in every aspect, including our security posture.

Read more: mccaul.house.gov/media-cente…

From foreign adversaries to cartels, bad actors are increasingly using drones to target infrastructure & innocent civilians. As the U.S. prepares to host millions of visitors for the FIFA World Cup & America250 celebrations, we must be prepared to neutralize this evolving threat.

Texas is home to more than 3.5 million small businesses, which serve as the backbone of our local economy. The best thing the federal government can do for them is get out of their way — and reduce oppressive taxes that stifle their impact.

That's why I was proud to vote for the Working Families Tax Cuts, which made permanent the 20% small businesses deduction. @HouseGOP will always fight for our nation's small businesses!

Congratulations to @TAMU's new president, Susan Ballabina! I'm confident she will lead the College Station campus with excellence as Texas A&M continues to reach new heights.




Texas A&M University (@TAMU)

.@tamusystem Board of Regents unanimously voted to appoint Dr. Susan Ballabina as the 28th president of Texas A&M University earlier today. Dr. Ballabina will assume her new role on May 11.

Read more: tx.ag/28thPresident

As the son of a WWII bombardier, I know the sacrifices that our service members and their families make to defend our great nation. During Military Appreciation Month, please join me in thanking the men and women who risk everything for our freedom. 🇺🇸


House Republicans (@HouseGOP)

Every sunrise over America is a gift, paid for by the courage of those who wear the uniform.

From the battlefields of Lexington to the deserts of the Middle East, generations of American warriors have given their

As chairman of @HomelandGOP's Special Events Task Force, I will continue doing everything in my power to ensure the World Cup games are fun and safe for everyone involved. Our next order of business must be funding CBP and ICE — including ICE's crucial Homeland Security Investigations office, which leads essential anti-human trafficking efforts at large-scale sporting events.

I strongly applaud the passage of today’s DHS funding bill, which is critical for closing security gaps ahead of our upcoming FIFA World Cup games. Despite Democrats' attempts to play political games with ICE and CBP, I am also glad this bill funded CBP's National Targeting Center, which works to identify and stop travelers and cargo that pose a threat to our nation. With only 42 days left until kickoff, DHS must be operating at peak capacity.

After sitting back-to-back with @SandraSmithFox at the White House Correspondents' Dinner, I joined her on @AmericaRpts to discuss the aftermath of the shooting and my thoughts on the venue's security.

Video

As chairman of @HomelandGOP's Special Events Task Force, I led a letter to Secretary Hegseth, Acting AG Blanche, & Secretary Mullin, urging the admin to empower the National Guard to address potential drone-related threats & ensure a unified federal security posture at the games. mccaul.house.gov/media-cente…
